evidence_plan.requirement: comparison of pivot-based baselines with other methods

payload.reason: The evidence provides definitions and comparisons of pivot-based baselines in the context of translation models.

claims.text: Pivot-based baselines include traditional transfer learning, pivot-based methods, and multilingual NMT.
Pivoting is the strongest baseline, outperforming other methods in zero-shot translation scenarios.
The performance of pivot-based methods is significantly improved when combined with other techniques like MLM and TLM.
